reviews.title: Fun! Until…
reviews.text: Look, I get games want to make money. But there should be the option to play by watching ads. They still make money off me this way as well. I was attracted me to this game, along with the unique concept, because you could watch ads to gain “energy” to play. UNTIL day 30 in the game (not in real time). Then, the button to watch ads to gain energy suddenly doesn’t let you watch ads. It says “ads aren’t available in your area, try again later.” I’ve tried for three solid days, at multiple times, and it keeps giving me that message, one I never got before. You do get 5 energy bolts every day that renew, but that’s basically enough to play for a half hour. So I look at the subscription prices, and like most of these games, they are ridiculously high for a game you don’t even own ($200 A YEAR). The weekly rate is crazy too. The reason I’m annoyed, is this feels like a bait and switch. They get you involved in the game for free, and as soon as you’re invested in the world, no more ads, you have to pay. It gets triggered after a certain amount of time or something, it won’t let you watch ads to earn energy. I’m going to give it one more day, and if I still can’t get an ad to play so I can continue the game, I’m deleting and moving on. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Please improve your app!!

The fact that you only get 5 energy makes it feel so limited, and it gets boring really quickly. It also feels very money-hungry, like the app is constantly pushing you to spend just to enjoy features that should be more accessible.

And on top of that, it keeps glitching whenever I try to post. Sometimes it doesn’t upload properly or something just goes wrong, which makes the whole experience even more annoying. 

It could honestly be such a fun and engaging app if the energy system were more generous and the posting glitches were fixed. The potential is there—I just wish the app would actually let us enjoy it.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your time

So with that I deleted my account and started again, since I couldn’t physically even play the game, I felt like I had to. And once i made that new account, to my surprise my upgrade was no longer there, yet the money has left my account, seems mighty convenient.

Then there’s the matter of it being slow and buggy, I had to restart the game countless times, and when trying to reopen it, it would frequently get stuck causing me to need to actually restart my phone. 

Honestly, do yourself a favour and don’t bother with this game. I can appreciate a

reviews.text:
This app used to be so fun. It is now one of the worst ai apps there is. It went from unlimited actions to five a day.  You have to spend money to get more, and it's not worth it as the characters become OOC after a while and forget everything you've built in your universe. 

But that isn't what bothers me most. The newest update where you have stories is the worst feature I've ever experienced. And I know I am not the only one as I've read the community discord and everyone feels the same way. 

You now get stories like you would on Instagram but it'd from any character made within the universe (so you'll have 10+ stories from a character all with a different personality and comeoltly unrelated to your story) and you get posts from real people. The immersion is comepltly ruined. I was happy when I say ew could disable stories but guess what? It's behind a pay wall. 

It's a shame how downhill this app has gone within a year. I'll be deleting it now

reviews.title: things have changed.
reviews.text: i was one of the first people to play this game when it was first developed. i participated in the discord server, gave feedback, discussed features with devs and other players, etc. it’s a bit disappointing to see how many ads are now in the game, to the point that there is an ad after every single post/event interaction. the “proactive character” feature was something we BEGGED for as players, one of the most popular features we repeatedly said would be extremely beneficial to the game, but now you have to pay an extremely pricey subscription fee to get it? the features that make the game more immersive and fun should not be so limited. not to mention, only 5 energy a day is INSANE. we used to get more than that as free players even when the game first came out…i’m honestly really really disappointed in how the game prioritizes profit. yes, everyone needs to make money, but we really into this game from the beginning and gave all our advice and feedback on how to make the game more fun and interactive for everyone. and now, the best part of the game—interaction—is paywalled. $80 a year for only 15 actions a day is NOT worth it. we were getting 15 actions a day for free before. it makes me genuinely sad bc the idea for this was so fun and i was really excited for the devs to work on it more.

Give us more actions a day and make our characters actually respond to our tweets! My game wont even open, I spend more time trying to open the app than I do playing. It gets to a point and it’s just not fun anymore.

yo, this app genuinely has so many ads that it’s becoming really unplayable if you don’t have status plus or premium, or whatever. yeah, the UI is better, but bro, there are more ads than actual gameplay at this point. it feels like an illegal website with how often they pop up

and how the hell do you even start off with zero energy?:/ it completely ruins the purpose of the app because you can barely do anything without waiting or watching another ad. I expected this app to be so much better after being here for like a year or so

I’ve been here since they used to give us codes just to actually play the game, so seeing how much it has changed is honestly disappointing. I get that ads and premium features are probably part of keeping the app running, but this feels excessive. the app had so much potential, and it’s frustrating seeing the experience get worse instead of better:/

reviews.title: The Ends Don’t Justify the Means ($$$)
reviews.text: I could see how this app could be fun. But the fun is MASSIVELY outweighed by the cost. Literally. When you first download the app, you get 1 daily energy and then you have 10 bonus energy. And that’s it’s. Once you’re out of energy, there’s nothing you can do unless you watch a video for 1 single energy and even then you have to wait 30 seconds between videos AND random adds show up randomly too. The app also keeps very heavily pushing for you to purchase Plus. Which, I was having a good time and was considering it until I looked at the price. It’s almost $200 per year and you get add free plus an extra $40 daily energy. The problem? You can’t get any more than 50 energy per day, it takes a lot of energy to interact and post snd so the energy is used VERY quickly, and the price is way too high for the things you get. I’m surprised anyone purchases it because it just simply isn’t worth it. I am not above dropping $200 for a yearly subscription for an app I’m actually going to get to use and has a lot of bells and whistles and reasons why I actually might pay that. You’re paying $200 essentially for just energy because everything you could do relies on that. I find this app pointlessly expensive with a lot of creator profit with very little reward for the spenders. Dont be hoodwinked by a spur of the moment thing.

reviews.title: Fun But Disappointing
reviews.text:
Ive really enjoyed playing this game and I spent money on the weekly pass to stretch my enjoyment out a bit longer. This brings me to a couple issues Ive found. 

The first is that your daily energy refreshes every day at 12am and Im a pretty busy person so I dont typically spend all the energy before the day is up and I find it wasteful that the 20-30 energy I have is just converted back to 50. The extra energy left over should convert to boosts, bonus energy, or gems. Its energy I paid for so I dont get why it just disappears. Ive lost about 140ish unspent energy because of this.

The other issue Ive come across is my daily pass expired today so I assumed Id be able to use the 50 energy and then have to pay for the pass again but when I logged in I found that my daily energy had gone back to 0. It's pretty upsetting that the energy I spent money on just disappeared because my pass expired. The game was fun but because of this, I dont think Ill be downloading it again.

reviews.title: great at first but now its horrible
reviews.text: I have just deleted the app. this game was actually so good, i loved it so much and had so much fun, until a few days ago. I have wasted hours of my life watching adverts to get energy. every time you want to post, you have to watch a two minute long advert, then you have to watch ANOTHER thirty second pop up add straight after. then, when you create an event and try read the outcome, the whole app freezes. i loved this so much and had such high hopes, but the adverts are actually the worst i've ever seen it makes me want to crawl in a hole and gain my wasted hours that i've spent watching adverts back. i have managed to recite the whole testerup advert off by heart because of how repetitive and frequent these adverts are.

reviews.title: Only play if you can pay
reviews.text: If you are wanting to play this for free then I wouldn’t bother downloading it. The energy system screws anyone who doesn’t want/have the money to pay for a daily/weekly subscription. After you use up your initial energy there is almost no free way of getting more unless you want to watch one ad for one energy. Don’t expect to be able to do everything that the ads show for this game for free, most of it you have to subscribe for. It would be amazing if the energy could refill daily or watch 2-3 ads for a full refill. Even just being able to decide the relationship of one follower would be good. Clearly the subscription is a way of money grabbing. Apart from this, it’s fun to play and easy to use. There is a wide range of different universes. I just don’t know how much longer I can deal with watching a single ad for one energy (which is one action). If you fixed this issue you would have a lot more players. :/

reviews.title: Rotted with time :(
reviews.text: I was one of the first to download this app, back when people were let in by groups and it was first come first serve on discord the second that invite link went out. I say all this to show that I am coming from a place of disappointment like a parent catching your child cheating on their partner. The app used to have more, now EVERTHING is pay locked or ruined. The Dm feature? Pay locked. The passive energy recharge? Removed to now ONCE a day for five. Adding a character dynamic? Pay locked. And that is just the beginning of it. I used to love this app but coming back to it is like seeing the ruins of Rome. It once was great on now I’m left searching for the scraps of that greatness! I understand needing money but why didn’t you beg and pay locked everything when you first started? If you didn’t need it then, them you probably don’t need it now. And if you’re still desperate, that’s why we have ads. Do you know how jarring it was to see the DM’s locked behind a membership when I used to be able to use it no strings attached? In the end, the app Rotted with time and it’s hard to see the game I used to like underneath the pay locks and memberships. Please, at the least, replace some of the pay lock with ads. My heart breaks that I even had to write this.

reviews.title: Fun for one day
reviews.text: This game was fun for the few hours I was allowed to play. There was a whole day timer for more energy, but even when it ran down to 00:00 I did not get more energy. Since this is an app heavily advertised I figured it’s just a game meant to get the users to spend money. I played it the one day, and once I saw even after waiting the whole day for more energy that it was just a way to make me impatient and spend money to get more energy instead I deleted it. This app had great potential but if it’s just a ai cash grab than I rather not spend my money on a game that can’t even be up front about trying to make me spend money. Many other people in the review are talking about unfulfilled promises to get of the wait time for energy and many people say that even paying doesn’t get them any more energy than normal, to the point that it seems like paying is no different from playing free. Again, this app has great potential but even if it seems worth it, it seems like the developers don’t care about the people who enjoy playing it.

reviews.title: Downhill updates
reviews.text: I had JUST gotten the app after seeing an ad about it and decided on a whim to try and have fun with it. It was already full of issues, like the app not loading when trying to first open to the point I was closing it out and opening it over and over to see if it ever loaded, occasionally freezes, lag. When it DID load, it was fun. But there was not enough energy to have more than like 20-30 minutes of fun since I was given bonus energy instead of a full battery of daily energy to start with (and ai would have to pay for more, there is no recharge for free users unless you’re randomly offered bonus energy). After that, it was watching ads over and over, 2 for every 1 point of energy just to either reply to a post, make a post, experience an event, OR DM. Tedious, and takes away from the experience. Now the next evening (not even 24 hours!) there is an update that just increases the ads! I went from being able to scroll and read without interruptions and choosing to watch ads willingly for energy to HAVING A RANDOM AD POP UP WHAT SEEMS LIKE EVERY MINUTE. Honestly, a waste of time at this point. I would have endured if it wasn’t for that update. Now? Deleting account and the app.

reviews.title: So many poor choices
reviews.text: Okay, so firstly I saw this app on Insta and decided to try it since I love the sims. I start playing and I’m having fun but then OH! More energy needed. I see it says “daily energy 0/0” at the top so I assume it will reset, even though it doesn’t make sense to say 0/0 if it can max out. Like most sensible games, you assume it will right? Heck it might even carry over. I go online to find out when it resets and I see that for NEW players it won’t reset at all. You can gain ONE energy by watching 2 adverts. 2 90 second ads. No other way, oh except payment! The highest subscription is near £200 a year which, for glorified DAYDREAMING is insane. Apparently the energy used to reset but for new players it won’t anymore. So how is that going to incentivise new players to..play??? Also! The ads run out. I read that after a certain amount of time the ads run out and the game is rendered useless. What a complete waste of time. Fix the energy system, give 3-5 per day, award energy for achievements, let it carry over. You gotta make money sure, but look at WAY more successful games like this. The currency can be earned freely without watching slop ads.

reviews.title: GET RID OF THE ADS EVERY 5 SECONDS??
reviews.text: This app is amazing, I really feel like it’s better than c.ai, janitor ai, chai, etc. because it provides an open world experience for you to make your mark in. The issue is the ads and the hell spawn of greed the devs have. As annoying as it is, I can *kinda* get by with having to watch ads for energy, or sharing it to people for a free coffee. The thing I CANT get by is the new up date they literally added while I was playing that puts automatic ads every time I go somewhere. If I’m trying to check the replies of my tweet? AD. If I’m trying to talk with my f/o about a cute coffee date? AD. If I’m trying to scroll on the tl and play the stupid game? AD. AD AD AD. You people are greedy, and this is too far. Literally, all it takes is for an app similar to this one (that’s not greedy and allows you to actually play the game without ads) gets put up, then you guys are doomed and all the people here are gonna switch. That life ai app is already being made, and I bet there’s a handful more apps like these that are being made as well. So please make parts of the app functional without ads….

reviews.title: So much potential
reviews.text: The app is so cool BUT after about a day you run out of energy and literally can’t click a button without watching at least 2 30 second ads. It gets super annoying and unfortunately the only way out is to pay almost $400 a year.

reviews.title: Filled with bugs and glitches
reviews.text: This app has honestly become horrible lately. It constantly urges users to pay extra for almost every action you make in the app, which completely ruins the experience. I used to genuinely enjoy using it, but now it’s filled with bugs and glitches. So many times I try to do an action, the app takes away my energy, yet nothing actually happens because it glitches out. Losing energy for actions that don’t even go through is incredibly frustrating. Please fix the bugs instead of pushing nonstop paid features.

reviews.title: Pay to play.
reviews.text: I downloaded this app after seeing an ad and was so excited to play. At first it was great when I had energy but when I ran out I realised it was impossible to get more unless I watched ads (which eventually ran out) or paid for more energy per day. There’s no daily refresh on energy UNLESS you pay and it’s not really affordable either. Great app ruined by greed. Even if the premium subscription was a cheaper I would’ve considered it as the game was so fun but it’s way too much. Sad because developers probably would’ve made more money this way rather than being greedy. Save yourself any time and don’t download. good game but unless you want to pay to be able to play it’s not worth it.

reviews.title: Pay to Play
reviews.text:
No doubt, this AI  app is the second best to c.ai. I love how it actively allows you to interact with fictional characters through social media, as either a fictional character themself or playing as yourself. I also love how we’re able to build a variety of relationships with different characters and with different dynamics.

However.

Having only 8 energy max per account with NO daily energy unless you’re a subscribed member is absurd. This concept leaves the user no choice but to either buy energy, buy the subscription, or watch two ads for ONE energy if you don’t want to pay. The ad option may seem a bit more appealing, but I heavily dislike that; that’s the only free option to acquire energy. I believe there should be more options to acquire energy, like side quests/tasks for users to complete, for example.

Not only that, but upon deleting the app as I was having technical issues getting into my account, I logged back in with my same email to see that it created a whole new account for me, my progress completely gone from existence. This also happened when I purchased the $0.99 coffee, which I did NOT receive, so I’m currently waiting for a refund if I can get it.

Overall, this game is an amazing concept of an interactive AI app with different fictional characters and scenarios and has the potential to be an even better game if these issues were addressed.

Thank you.

reviews.title: Awesome app, but one issue…
reviews.text:
I just started using Status today, but one thing: it keeps glitching and getting stuck. I tried joining a sim when I had no energy and I made a character to play as, but the app was stuck loading the sim once I got everything set up for it. I refreshed the app and it just kept coming back to the loading sim page even though I had nothing selected. I had to delete the app and sign in again to fix this issue.

EDIT:
Second day using the app and my “daily energy” hasn’t refilled and I keep having to watch ads to get more energy. Might I suggest making a timer refill? (Like you get X number of energy for X amount of cooldown time like stamina in certain games. 1 energy bar per 4 minutes sounds like a standard trade of time for stamina.) also, I’d like to ask for a higher energy count because five energy gets used in the snap of your fingers if you aren’t constantly thinking about what you use your energy to do.

reviews.title: Pay to Play System. Don’t Download.
reviews.text: This app has become entirely unusable. I first found this app when it initially came out a year or so ago from a recommendation from a friend. I messed around with it for a bit, found it fun, and eventually after a month or so deleted it when I got bored. Recently, I got an ad for it and decided to redownload it for fun. Bad idea. This app is practically unusable for new players, which I think is the opposite of what any app would want to be, but I digress. Gone is the energy bar ! Instead you get 5 actions the first day, and once those are used up, they are gone. Fun fact, energy does not reset if you aren’t a ‘subscribed’ user, meaning you practically HAVE to spend money if you ever want to use it after that. And even then, you STILL have a limited amount of actions, meaning you have to spend even more money on coffees or whatever to keep using it. It is the definition of greed. I would never in good conscience recommend this. The lack of transparency here really sold the fact the state of the app now comes from a place of greed, with me having to find out from reddit of all things that I basically cannot use this app unless I spend money now. Don’t waste your time.

reviews.title: actually unusable garbage
reviews.text: this game was fun when it first came out but i redownloaded and you genuinely can’t use it without paying. you have a very small amount of “energy” — a certain amount of plays you can make each day that says IN THE APP it resets the next day but its a lie. it never resets, i waited days just to play a few more times in my world and it NEVER resets. you HAVE to subscribe to play the game after your first day playing. it’s fully pay to play garbage. there’s an option to watch ads to gain more energy that doesn’t even work. don’t trust any reviews on here, reviewing is just another way they promise the players a small amount of energy they’ll use up in 2 seconds. don’t buy this game. greedy as hell for money developers that obviously spend up all their money on tik tok ads instead of actually making this game decent. forcing you to pay for ai of all things is crazy download chatgpt and make them roleplay as your favorite characters or something at least you’ll actually be able to do something

reviews.title: Ads not working
reviews.text: Ads to get more energy is not working. I’m not gonna spend money to get more energy for an app that barely knows how to function properly. This app was fun until you reduced the energy limit. How do you expect people to only post five things and have to wait 24hrs?? If anything maybe change the reset to an hour, that’s more reasonable. I’ve tried to run ads to get more energy and it’s not working saying that there’s “no more ads left”. Please fix the things people have actually reviewed instead of constantly changing the UI. If you want your app to thrive maybe you should start listening to your consumers…

reviews.title: Fun but expensive w/ potential
reviews.text: Honestly a good app yes.. very fun you could get addicted & then boom you lose energy which is crazy because after that you have to wait a WHOLE OTHER DAY to get more energy and it's less than 10 energy's. If you buy the subscriptions / coffees then good for you but it's honestly not worth it—the creators might not understand how fun the game actually is & 120 coffees for $40 is kind of mad regardless of it adding up to 960 energy the game is like a pay to play which isn't really good imo.. And watching 3 ads for 1 energy is just overly dumb & time wasting when it could've & should've been 3 ads for 12 energy (3x4) BTW the app wasn't always pay to play.. and if it was going to be like that Id rather have them make it where you pay to download the app & energy's being completely free.. no possible cooldown or anything I understand trying to earn money but the least they can do is be less expensive considering the whole thing is just literally ai + its gotten bad that theres 2 other people working on a similar app to this and making it better. Honestly this criticism has been told to the creator on tiktok millions of times & she just ignores it which is why most people delete the app after first time playing it she doesn't even try to make the app usable.

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: Took a break from playing it,I used to play it nearly every day. I really enjoyed how even though you had to wait after a certain period of time,you could use around three energies that would refill themselves and you could tell when they were refilled by the colour they were. Made the game playable for a while longer. Just tried it once more and there is only five energies you can use,that do not refill after a short amount of time,very disappointing as the game has always tried its best to not be a ‘pay to play’ sort of thing. Waiting around  24hours for five single interactions is ridiculous and unrealistic to create an enjoyable game. Would be nice if there was a one fee for unlimited energy sort of thing,not a subscription,or going back to the old energy system.

reviews.title: Pay to play
reviews.text: You only get enough energy to be on here for 10 minutes. If I want to sit down and play a game or read a story, I want to do it in one sitting when I can pay attention. Not when I can pay for a made up currency. I downloaded this because TikTok advertised it as a game I could use to interact with my favorite characters in a way that was different from chat apps. The characters often sound like they’re speaking nonsense, and there’s not enough to do. Not only can I chat more on c.ai, I can feel more fulfilled after. This app just rage baited me until i decided the wasted storage wasn’t worth it. This is the first review I’ve ever left on an app because I was so infuriated logging in to see I could only do 5 things before waiting when I had 5 million ideas. There just isn’t a way to make it fit. At this point I’m switching to actual writing/books. This just proves if it ain’t broke don’t fix it. Anyone else reading this, i encourage you all to go visit Ao3 and give your time to the beautiful authors on there instead. They don’t make you pay for real imagination. 1 star.

reviews.title: It’s 3 1/2 stars really
reviews.text:
Tbh, the game has lots of potential being greedy wasn’t involved. Now I currently have a subscription because I wanted to see just how good the subscription is and if it was even worth it and I have to say, the only good thing you get from the subscription is more energy. There’s no other perks. So if you are planning on getting the subscription, just know you’re just gonna get more energy. When you don’t have the subscription, you’re really out of luck lol if you use all five of your energy in five minutes then you’re gonna have to wait a whole 24 hours to get more. 
I think it would be cool if we could earn coffee through one of the purple daily check boxes. That may make people actually want to play it more. I think the amount of energy is the main reason why this entire app has gone downhill from when it was first launched. If you can get that fixed, then I’m sure you’ll start seeing so much more people take interest in the app. As someone who was incredibly into it when it first came out, I’ve definitely lost a few interest in it because it’s just incredibly hard to actually do anything with it when you have very little energy so I can imagine how other people who don’t have the money to have subscriptions may feel. But that’s just my experience and everyone’s different.

reviews.title: The downfall of this app highkey shocked me.
reviews.text:
Ok, let’s be clear I started playing this probably late 2024 and I can’t lie the concept was amazing. The characters felt like people instead of like robots. And the app felt engaging to the point you’d actually want to comeback to it. And even though the maintenance issue was frustrating it was something that I could work with cause I genuinely enjoyed the app.

Honestly I don’t know how this started. The maintenance issue was one thing but I recently checked back in with the app after maybe three months of not playing and the quality kinda just plummeted. For starters, the characters feel less like characters and more like robots. Which I could’ve over looked, but when the action went from maybe 50-35 actions a day to 5? Before you could split up your actions cause they lasted at least 2-3 hours maybe more if you were going through all the messages and get lost in the app. But apparently they’re telling us to get off the app and go touch grass cause five actions is barely even a minute. For newbies, it takes at least one action to actually start a scenery so that’s at least one action already gone. There’s not enough to actually get into the game. And I feel like if you’re going to charge users for additional action people would more than likely be more willing to pay for extra action if they’re already enjoying the way the scenario is going.  They’d have to be into it. Not to mention you’re only paying for the app to still be limited. They’d have to be into it. TBH this is

reviews.title: well..
reviews.text: This game was actually genuinely fun to play back when we had a decent amount of actions. I would spend hours on it and even then waste $2-$10 getting more coffee. It’s honestly really disappointing how money hungry the developers have became. No one wants to pay for a subscription for an app that could EASILY be f2p. Not everyone has the money to afford a subscription, if you can’t afford to run an app, shut it down. It’s really disgusting and honestly embarrassing that they even think people have the money for that. I understand that you don’t have money to support how expensive AI has become but it’s sickening that you think people have the money to pay for WEEKLY subscriptions. Not monthly, not yearly, WEEKLY. Seriously, almost $2 PER week for only 10 extra actions. Come on, if you want people to pay to use the app, AT LEAST make it reasonable! 5 actions a day is completely unfair to the people who supported you when the app launched. You could have at least gave us 10. 5 is just extremely greedy & money hungry. Overall, don’t play this game if you don’t have the money. It’s EXTREMELY pay2win, you physically CAN’T play if you don’t have a subscription. Hopefully the developers come to a realization after they lose more than half of their players. Atrocious.

reviews.title: no
reviews.text: i used to really love playing this and i had tons of little storylines built from multiple fandoms. when i saw the message on discord that we could start paying for energy through the app after months of the devs saying we would get a full version with NO action bar at all, i knew where this app was headed. having only 5 actions a day is actually ridiculously greedy and terrible for both retention and growth of your game. if it costs the devs money to have certain features, then make it an option to pay for those features instead of forcing the entire playerbase to pay for a weekly subscription just to have cohesive storylines. it’s not that i don’t have the money to do it, but it’s that on top of buying groceries, gas, paying for subs to other companies just to have any sort of entertainment, i rather not spend more money to just have a fun time. after months of having this game, i will be deleting this off my phone. the lack of transparency from the get go is a major problem and is extremely disappointing.

reviews.title: unplayable with 5 actions every 24 hours
reviews.text: i was fortunate to experience this app when we had 20 actions when the app was new & it was so the system doesn't crash with the amount of people accessing it (which was reasonable since it was new) BUT NOW we can only do 5 actions every 24 hours and they are making us pay a subscription for actions when their first promise was to make an AI app that is accessible for everyone. reviews.title: Money hungry game don’t play unless you got some funds to spare.

reviews.title: this is a mess
reviews.text:
when i first started playing this game at the beginning of the year, i had high hopes. it was fun, it was creative, it was new. there were a couple of flaws, but the one main issue i had when it officially launched (without using codes to enter) was how the app was totally unprepared for how much advertising it got.
afterwards, the app was constantly going down, maintenance was a regular thing, and there were still some issues with the app that they didn’t fix prior to launch. 
and then they kept doing those competitions to get more people on the app, use more coffees, and just making the servers crash almost daily.
i remember when the devs used to insist that they didn’t want the app to have any way to pay them. of course, this is no longer the case. we were fine with the option to pay for extra coffees, and I would argue that they should’ve had a way to donate directly to them in the first place. 
but the fact remains that this app was simply not ready for so many users, and they shouldn’t have advertised it as much for the sake of their limited servers. 
now they’re trying to fix it, but with subscriptions, limiting the free uses for everyone else. all of our trust is gone, and the app is still buggy. many users aren’t happy, and it feels like the devs aren’t listening. even in the discord, there aren’t many users that are happy or okay with the changes.
i had such high hopes for this game, but it doesn’t seem like it’ll go back to the way it was before.

reviews.title: Was good but now is a money grab
reviews.text:

 “in march 8th 2025 people were finally realizing that the devs were lying about the whole "6 developers" excuse and found out it's actually just a company called wishroll which let the status server getting locked and an announcement from fi threatening to take "legal action" if people kept exposing them(but she said misinformation instead although there are PLENTY of evidence)“. Take this information as you will. 

5 actions a day unless you pay extortionate prices because they spend their money for knows where, and we all know paying for a subscription actually puts money into their banks rather than back into the game.

They barely listen to the community, and turn a blind eye when suggestions appear to make it at-least 8 actions every 24 hrs.

They have constant bugs, and have 17M that is apparently being invested.

They gave up on this for their new app which is not even that good in comparison.

The concept is good, but be wary. These people are one step away from treating its users as cash cows.

reviews.title: super good app! only needs minor tweaks
reviews.text:
this app is soooo good!! but the energy thing is way annoying. i understand they need to make money somehow, but it’s super aggravating to get into the conversations only to be cut off. maybe make it so you can watch ads to earn energy? that way you can still get money but we won’t have to pay to earn more

reviews.title: Buggy and incredibly goofy outcomes
reviews.text: The app used to be fun, i.e back in January, however the outcome results have lost the plot and often provide you with very silly and completely OOC outcomes, e.g; it gave me sentient machines in a real-life scenario, it’s repeating the same phrases such as “Congratulations, you have…” and it ended up driving me away from the app completely. You used to be able to train the AI model yourself however that is no longer possible. It’s so disappointing to see how much this app has fallen because it used to be so good and entertaining, and now I don’t use it at all. Not to mention the sudden decrease in actions, so now you can only use it for 1/8th of what you used to. I used to rant and rave about this app but now I simply can’t. I can’t believe I ever spent money on this, albeit it was back when the app was actually good. I will not be paying anything further until the AI model gets better, and even then I don’t think I’ll ever come back as I’ll no longer be able to trust the devs as they have become so out of touch with their user base. C’est la vie.

reviews.title: IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ
reviews.text:
this used to be one of my favourite apps id use in my free time. i loved the social media framing of the app, how interactions worked and how responsive the ai was too! it was so innovative

unfortunately the app has long since gone downhill. there is an energy system that has existed since launch, and over the past few months (potentially leading up to a year?) the system has been completely broken. one action is supposed to equal to one energy, with a total of 15-ish energy per day, so 15 actions. people have long since been getting only 10 actions or less, and some even have 0 actions repeatedly across multiple days when they haven’t done anything on the app

the developers havent been able to keep up with the cost of the ai, so they’ve introduced a subscription, with the perks being more energy—the highest priced sub being for around 50 energy. this is a SCAM. the developers know about the energy bugs and have for months, and are doing nothing to fix it, all while implementing a pay-to-play functionality (slowly removing the amount of actions you have without paying). please don’t support this app financially, you will not get what you’re promised :(

reviews.title: So little energy
reviews.text:
You can literally only use the app for less than 30 mins before having to wait 24 hours to get your energy back or you has to spend money for more energy. I get not waiting people to play all day but I think 24 hours is excessive for how little time you actually get to play. I never used up all my energy before the change to decrease it. If the energy isn’t gonna change then the time for it to refill needs to. 

I saw someone say a 3 hour wait and the option to speed it up with ads and I don’t think that’s a bad idea. Or you could implement something like what C.AI has, where minors have the less energy and adults go back to the amount it was before. It would be better than everybody having less. (personally this is my favorite solution…)

I also saw someone mention hearing about a possible subscription for $10-$15 dollars. I think anything over than $10 is pretty greedy. I hope you take feedback and will try to find a way to make everyone happy.
